name: Just Funded: the full Twin Cities SBA borrower list
description: Every SBA 7(a) and 504 loan approved in the seven-county Twin Cities in the last twelve months: borrower, street, zip, NAICS, exact amount, lender, business age, and the spreadsheet. Re-pulled weekly; one password keeps working.
line: The full list, with street, zip, exact amount, lender and the spreadsheet, is $300, once.
